title: Dizziness or weakness

fields.question: Any sudden weakness or numbness on one side, face drooping, trouble speaking, or sudden vision loss?

rules.reason: Dizziness with an abnormal heartbeat needs same-day assessment.
Chest pain with dizziness needs same-day assessment.
The person rates the problem as severe.
Dizziness or weakness lasting two days or more.
The person rates the problem as moderate.

warning_signs: Sudden weakness, numbness or trouble speaking
source_notes: Rules are student-authored from the general principles in public triage guidance (NHS emergency advice, ESI handbook, WHO emergency triage). Source clause references still to be added; NOT clinically validated.
